hook_line: CANADA HOLDS STUDENT ARRIVALS TARGET AT UP TO 150,000 A YEAR THROUGH 2029

hook_stat.sub: Canada's target for new international student arrivals each year through 2029, held in the 2027–2029 Immigration Levels Plan

news_summary: Canada's 2027–2029 Immigration Levels Plan, released by IRCC alongside Budget 2026 on November 5, 2026, holds the target for new international student arrivals at up to 150,000 a year through 2029. India is Canada's largest source of students: 94,025 study permits that became effective in 2025 were for Indian nationals, 24.6% of the total.
payoff: The plan holds the student intake essentially flat rather than cutting it further, with the ceiling now set through 2029 — though the 2028 and 2029 figures are notional until IRCC confirms them.
